episodes.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((objs (objects-multicolor g 0)))
           (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
                     (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
                            (colors (unique (map (lambda (p) (at g (fst p) (snd p)))
                                                 cells))))
                       (if (!= 2 (length colors))
                           acc
                           (let* ((ka (first colors))
                                  (kb (nth colors 1)))
                             (reduce (lambda (g2 p)
                                       (set-cell g2
                                                 (fst p)
                                                 (snd p)
                                                 (if (= ka (at g (fst p) (snd p)))
                                                     kb
                                                     ka)))
                                     acc
                                     cells)))))
                   g
                   objs))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((objs (objects-multicolor g 0))
         (pair-of
          (lambda (obj)
            (sort
             (unique
              (map (lambda (p) (at g (fst p) (snd p)))
                   (obj-cells obj)))
             <)))
         (pairs
          (map pair-of
               (filter (lambda (obj) (= 2 (length (pair-of obj)))) objs))))
    (reduce
     (lambda (acc obj)
       (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
              (colors (pair-of obj))
              (copies
               (if (= 2 (length colors))
                   (length (filter (lambda (p) (equal? p colors)) pairs))
                   0)))
         (if (not (> copies 1))
             acc
             (let* ((ka (first colors)) (kb (nth colors 1)))
               (reduce
                (lambda (g2 p)
                  (set-cell g2 (fst p) (snd p)
                            (if (= ka (at g (fst p) (snd p))) kb ka)))
                acc cells)))))
     g objs))))
